topic: Micron share of global DRAM revenue, 2Q26
disagreement: TrendForce (7 Sep 2026) puts Micron at 23.3% of 2Q26 DRAM industry revenue; a September 2026 report of Counterpoint Research data puts Micron at 24% of the global DRAM and HBM market in 2Q26.
possible_reasons: Different research firms with different revenue models and supplier coverage
Counterpoint figure is rounded to whole percent and labelled 'DRAM and HBM'
Different treatment of quarter boundaries for Micron's non-calendar fiscal quarters
rationale: Both are third-party estimates of the same quantity; the 0.7-point gap is within normal method differences, and neither publishes its method. Cite the firm with the figure.
remaining_uncertainty: Neither firm discloses how it maps Micron's fiscal quarter (ending late May/June) to calendar 2Q26.
